items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps dry-looking skin comfortable while the retinol settles in.
The lower 0.3% retinol is a sensible starting strength for smoother-looking texture and a more even-looking tone.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream adds comfort and moisture for skin that scans on the dry side.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides is needed in the morning alongside retinol, and the tint blends well on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night just two nights a week at first, applied after cleansing and followed by the moisturizer, then add nights slowly as your skin feels comfortable. Apply the sunscreen every morning, and pause the retinol if skin feels stinging or looks irritated, since irritation can leave deeper skin tones looking uneven.
